subject: General Science
title: Plant Growth and Development

outcomes.text: explain the meaning of growth and development in plants,
describe the causes of seed dormancy in plants,
investigate the conditions necessary for germination,
differentiate between epigeal and hypogeal germination,
distinguish between primary and secondary growth in plants,
describe factors that contribute to growth and development in plants,
describe the role of growth hormones in plants,
appreciate the concept of growth and development in plants.

content: Concept of growth and development in plants
Primary and secondary growth in plants
Role of growth hormones in plants
inquiry_questions: Why is the concept of growth in plants important?
coreCompetencies:
Communication and collaboration: as the learner shares information gathered on differences between plant growth and development.
Self-efficacy: as the learner works on practical activities to investigate epigeal and hypogeal germination.
Learning to learn: as the learner reflects on the experiments investigating conditions necessary for germination.
values: Responsibility: Learner engages in assigned roles while working with others in the process of learning such as investigating conditions necessary for germination.
pcis: Cyber security: as the learner observes online safety when searching for information on growth and development of plants.
transcription_policy: Source wording retained;line breaks/bullets normalised;pixels authority.
notes: Germination/seedling observations need real multi-day scheduling;actual water/temperature comparisons and actual epigeal/hypogeal specimens remain separate from supplied data.
Light/nutrient needs for later growth differ from germination conditions;species-specific light/dormancy requirements must be qualified.
No hormone application,acid/hot-water scarification or unknown/mould culture;dormancy-breaking methods are researched conceptually and matched to species.
